section_summary.extract_value: This section reports factor structure analysis of the BAS-2 in a male subsample. Principal-axis exploratory factor analysis revealed that while two factors had eigenvalues greater than 1.00, parallel analysis suggested retaining only one factor explaining 49.9% of total variance, with all ten items loading adequately on the primary factor. Internal consistency was acceptable (Cronbach's α = .89).

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor structure analysis for the BAS-2 scale in a male subsample, with descriptive statistics and item-factor loadings shown in Table 1 for both male and female subsamples. Principal-axis exploratory factor analysis revealed one primary factor explaining 49.9% of variance, with all ten BAS-2 items loading adequately and acceptable internal consistency (Cronbach's α = .89) for men. The analysis includes parallel analysis and scree plot inspection to determine factor retention.
